verdict.rationale: Fin exposes a programmatic API and TypeScript SDK with a pagination iterator for looping over items, plus a content-import endpoint, implying some capacity for scripted bulk actions, but there is no documented bulk-edit, bulk-resolve, or batch-action feature for AI-native users. missing for 10: explicit bulk operation/batch endpoint documentation, hands-on evidence of processing many items in one call, and any UI/CLI bulk-action support.
